name: Nanaka
message: 「E-H-Hey, stop it... W-Why are you going out of your way to emphasize 'just the two of us' like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean... it's always just the two of us anyway, so just because it's Christmas Eve doesn't mean...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I get it... You're planning to do... something pervy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez. Y-You don't have to beat around the bush like that... If you wanna do it, you could just say so anytime...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Forget it, forget it! Let's go out after all! Let's go live it up! Live it up! I'm not letting you go home today!」
